label: CI/model result of pcb/board_gen.py in kicad/kicad:10.0.7; not a hardware PASS; bench gates OPEN

layers.source: mechanical/generated/contract/boards.json stackup (4 layers, JLC04161H-7628, build/15 "Шари") and pcb/generated/netclasses.json stackup
layers.types_why: In1.Cu (L2) carries a solid GND plane laid before routing and typed power, so the Specctra export marks it (type power) and Freerouting does not route on it; every SMD GND pad has its own scripted via to it. F.Cu, In2.Cu and B.Cu are routing layers; the power classes route on F.Cu/B.Cu only (router.class_layers), as pcb/check_boards.py requires (netclasses.json: no inner copper for PWR3A, 1.8 mm inner for PWR1A).

plan.F.Cu: L1: top parts, signals, scripted LAB5 feed J305 -> J314.2 (1.85 mm) and the first 10 mm of the right-group LAB5 feed (1.85 mm, y 64.5, to its six vias; W2 CTRL-4), the scripted E3_FAN5_P hop (0.8 mm, from its three vias below F301.2 over the LAB5 column to three vias left of it; W2 CTRL-4), scripted 3V3_Q6A pieces (right pull-up column, MCP pins), scripted E3_PICO3V3 pieces (HMI2/HMI3 bus along cut-out 1 to R368, up the right board edge to R395, the HMI pull-up row to C312 and U306, R361/R362), the frozen router copper of route run 43136394379 and its completion and increments (route-frozen.json), GND pour after routing
plan.In1.Cu: L2: GND plane (pre-route zone, DSN plane) with 17 locked slow signal links of the frozen route completion (250 mm in all; W2 CTRL-R, and the W2 CTRL-4 increment where it has added links): E3_FAN_EN 34.6 mm, E3_CASE_TEMP 29.6 mm, E3_PICO_SWCLK 21.2 mm, UART5_RX 20.1 mm, E3_FN_EXT 18.9 mm, E3_HMI_SCL 18.4 mm, EN_T7 16.9 mm, PWR_ON_KEY 16.4 mm, E3_REC_EXT 14.9 mm, E3_PICO_VSYS 12.2 mm, PWR_BUTTON 10.7 mm, E3_LED_DRIVE 9.3 mm, E3_MCP_RESET_N 7.9 mm, E3_PANEL_TEMP 7.7 mm, PG_BONI 4.7 mm, E3_MARK_EXT 4.4 mm, E3_U315_ILIM 2.1 mm; the plane flows around them
plan.In2.Cu: L3: signals (no LAB5 copper since W2 CTRL-4: the 0.6 mm L3 run to the right group is replaced by outer copper), the scripted 3V3_Q6A bus of the left pull-up column, the frozen router copper and its completion, GND pour after routing
plan.B.Cu: L4: bottom parts, signals, scripted E3_BLOWER_GND rail and E3_FAN5 (1.85 mm), the 1.85 mm LAB5 bar from J305.4 and E3_BLOWER_GND bar and riser of the blower capacitors C343/C342 (W2 CTRL-4), the scripted 1.85 mm LAB5 pieces (J314.2 -> D306, and the right-group feed: y 66.8 under cut-out 1 through D301.2, up the right strip through C320.1/R367.2 to Q304.2 and through C322.1 to the band between the cut-outs and C321.1/U315.1; W2 CTRL-4), scripted E3_FAN5_P (C319.1 -> C318.1 -> F301.2 and three vias right of the LAB5 column; three vias left of it, J313.2 and D305.1 at 0.6 mm; W2 CTRL-4), scripted E3_PICO3V3 pieces (R4B bus along cut-out 2, up the right strip and along the top edge to J312.4, branch to R362; Pico pin 36 escape via, R330/R327/C308), locked GND copper over the custom Pico GND pads, the frozen router copper and its completion, GND pour after routing
